package.name: cobot_control
package.description: C++ ROS 2 node that owns the Motoman link (YMConnect SDK, vendored in third_party/). Hardware primitives only: MoveToPose action (progress feedback, immediate cancel, pause/resume), IO / variable / alarm services, and a 10 Hz /cobot/state poll of everything read from the controller. Reads the controller profile (system info, TOOL.CND, UFRAME.CND) once per connect - strictly read-only - and owns the active tool selection. Choreography lives in cobot_operation; sequencing in cobot_tasks. Replaces the pybind extension motoman_cpp (retired, kept for scripting).
